device.description: 8-bit 70 kSPS 8-channel SAR ADC with internal 2.5 V reference and I2C interface
device.note: ads7830.pdf (SBAS302C) p.2 pin configuration and descriptions, p.3-6 electrical characteristics (2.7 V and 5 V: conversion time 5 us, straight binary, hardware address 10010), p.13 address byte, command byte, Table 1 power-down selection, p.14 Table 2 channel selection, initiating conversion, reading data, p.15 Figure 15 F/S read, p.16 Figure 16 HS read, p.17-18 internal reference

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the last command byte (SD C2 C1 C0 PD1 PD0 X X); no read-back, reset value not documented

commands.name: Command Byte
commands.note: Table 2: C2-C0 select CH0/CH2/CH4/CH6 (C2=0) or CH1/CH3/CH5/CH7 (C2=1) as +IN; the map gives the +IN channel in both SD modes

pages: p.2 (pins), p.3-6 (specs: VDD 2.7-3.6 V and 4.75-5.25 V, 5 us conversion, straight binary, address 10010), p.13-14 (address/command byte, Tables 1-2, read format), p.15-16 (Figures 15-16), p.17-18 (reference)
notModeled: analog inputs, multiplexer, single-ended/differential selection (SD, C2-C0 are stored only) and the internal reference (PD1)
power-down selection PD1-PD0 (Table 1): every command byte starts a conversion regardless of PD; ADC-off state (PD = 10) not modeled
HS mode master code and clock stretching while the conversion runs; I2C timing limits
vcc covers the two specified supply ranges (2.7-3.6 V and 4.75-5.25 V) as one range 2.7-5.25 V; the 3.6-4.75 V gap is not specified by the datasheet
CTRL reset value is not documented (0 used; the internal reference is off at power-on, which matches PD1 = 0)
reads before any command byte: the datasheet says data can only be read once a conversion has been initiated; the model returns the 0 V code
variants: 8-bit sibling of the ADS7828 (same pinout, address and command byte; one data byte per read)
